notes.title: A Shot in the Dark: May 17, 2024 Dev Log
notes.content:
[i]This dev log was originally posted on Patreon and SubscribeStar on May 17, 2024.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42292405/c8eb28991d6da104bc99d3df57e8606eb362de0d.png[/img]
[h1]Chapter 5 Development[/h1]
Last week [b]Josselyn[/b] and our coder, [b]Cosmic Mirage[/b], had a productive voice call going over plans for the [b]Murder Mystery Game[/b] we'll be integrating into [b]Chapter 5[/b].

We have enough assets made (backgrounds, sprites, GUI) and enough dialogue written to start playing around with implementation. We also hope to get [b]m.[/b] (who recently remade the GUI for both of our games) involved with some new GUI elements to give the [b]Murder Mystery Game[/b] a unique feel, separate from the main story of the game.

We'll include some previews of how it's all coming together in future dev logs! To get a taste of what it will look like, you can check out our previous dev log for previews of the backgrounds and look for the outfit polls we'll be doing this month and next.

Other than that, [b]Josselyn[/b] has been slowly chipping away at the writing and rendering, which is pretty typical for this phase of the development cycle. Currently, the written word count for [b]Chapter 5[/b] is around ~15K words and ~400 renders have been made (including the previously mentioned assets for the [b]Murder Mystery Game[/b]).

[h1]Translated Builds[/h1]
Another thing we hope to achieve during this development cycle is translated builds of [i][b]A Shot in the Dark[/b][/i] through [b]Chapter 4[/b], which we know many of our Steam players are eagerly awaiting. Once we have builds they will still have to be tested thoroughly before they are released, but we're getting very close to having builds ready to test!

[h1]Voice Acting[/h1]
Lastly, we are excited to announce we are working with [b]HaruLuna[/b] and other voice actresses to add more voice acting to the game (both to previous chapters and future ones)! We tried out voice acting for the first time with the [b]Ashley[/b] scene in [b]Chapter 4[/b] (featuring [b]Cinder[/b]) and we were super happy with the results, so we've decided to do more. We'll have more information about that as we get further into the process.

[h1]Chapter 5 Previews[/h1]
Here are some previews from the first scene of [b]Chapter 5[/b] which is fully written and rendered. Just in case you were worried we weren't going to resolve the cliffhanger from [b]Chapter 4[/b], let this be proof that we won't leave you hanging. ;)

notes.title: A Shot in the Dark: May 3, 2024 Dev Log
notes.content:
[i]This dev log was originally posted on Patreon and SubscribeStar on May 3, 2024.[/i]

[h1]Chapter 4 Official Release[/h1]
[b]Chapter 4[/b] has now officially been released on all platforms, including Steam and Itch! The official release went smoothly and we are now working on getting [b]Chapter 4[/b] translated on Crowdin so that we can finally release some translated builds of the game!

If you are interested in helping improve translations for any of the following languages, [url=https://crowdin.com/project/a_shotinthedark/invite/public?h=8cf5e0a0c99c77cc4c05f7cc1f4ea3202001280]check out our Crowdin page[/url] and reach out via the [url=https://discord.gg/6vZhWBqsTH]#translation-help channel on our Discord server[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42292405/f02276ac8b323cea4747378f4834c2895bc1dcd0.png[/img]
[h1]Chapter 5 Development[/h1]
As mentioned in previous dev logs, [b]Chapter 5[/b] has been in development for a while now. We've also mentioned before that we are going to be doing something totally new and different with [b]Chapter 5[/b] that we can't wait to tell you about!

We're excited to announce that [b]Chapter 5[/b] will have a 1920s themed Murder Mystery Game within it featuring all of your favorite [i][b]A Shot in the Dark[/b][/i] characters (a mini visual novel within a visual novel, if you will!). This has been an idea we've had since the very beginning, and originally the plan was to include it in [b]Chapter 3[/b], but as the story progressed we ultimately decided it made more sense in [b]Chapter 5[/b].

The story for the 1920s Murder Mystery Game is already set, and about a third of the content is written already. We also have created all of the backgrounds for the various locations in the mini game, as well as hair and outfit options for all the love interests who will be participating so that players can vote on their favorites on Patreon and SubscribeStar (which we will start doing next week!).

[b]Chapter 5[/b] will have regular scenes that advance the story and lewd scenes with 8 out of the 10 love interests, so don't worry. This is not a gimmicky chapter that will take away from "real" development time or progression with your favorite characters. :) This game-within-a-game was always planned to tie in with the actual story of the main game.

Without further ado, here are previews of the locations for the 1920s Murder Mystery Game coming in [b]Chapter 5[/b]!

notes.title: Chapter 4 update now available for A Shot in the Dark
notes.content:
[h1]Chapter 4 Official Release[/h1]
Official Public Release for players who own the game on Steam and Itch is here! This final version of [b]Chapter 4[/b] includes achievements for players on all platforms, not just Steam.

[h1]THIS IS A SAVE-BREAKING UPDATE![/h1]
[u][b]WARNING!!! SAVES WILL BE BROKEN THIS UPDATE![/b][/u] [b]Opening old saves will introduce bugs. Please plan to start a new game or use the [b]Entry Points[/b] feature to avoid opening old saves.[/b] To be safe, please consider deleting your old saves.

We know broken saves are a huge inconvenience for players, but unfortunately we made too many changes to the foundation of the codebase for it to be avoided. 

[h2]Verify Integrity of Game Files[/h2]
If you run into issues with downloading or accessing the [b]Chapter 4[/b] update, please try the "Verify integrity of game files" option in the Steam settings, in the Installed Files tab.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42292405/7f329eef2815fd8de18ca35674d00d905577b70c.png[/img]

[h1]Please report any bugs or issues[/h1]
If you encounter any bugs or issues with the game, please reach out to us directly so we can help you! You can post in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1853830/discussions/]Discussion forum here on Steam[/url], reach out to us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/7BtkMQCRmV]Discord server[/url], or contact our support email vimstudios.vns@gmail.com. If you report problems in a review, we may not see the report immediately.

[h1]What's new in Chapter 4?[/h1]
With this update we are adding: 16 scenes (9 lewd), ~55K+ words, 2,226 renders, 97 animations, 28 songs, and  21 sfx.

[h2]Ren'Py upgrade and code optimization[/h2]
This update we upgraded from Ren'Py 7.4.11 to Ren'Py 8+ which allows us to take advantage of the newer optimization features Ren'Py has to offer! We also took this opportunity to refactor our code to integrate well with Crowdin and help automate the translation process.

[h2]New Achievements feature added[/h2]
We've now added Achievements (which were previously only available via the Steam platform) to the game itself so that players on all platforms can access them! All players will get notifications when achievements are completed and can check in-game to see which achievements they have completed or not. If you have the Walkthrough features purchased and enabled, you can also get hints for the achievements in-game.

[h2]Unlock All Memories feature added[/h2]
We added the ability to Unlock All Memories with a toggle in the settings. We already had the feature that allows you Reset All Memories. These are quality of life features to help players who get stuck in bugged states, are playing on multiple platforms/devices that can't share saves, etc. Both can be found in the Options menu in the More tab.

[h2]Brand new GUI throughout entire game[/h2]
Thank you to m. of Tsundere Studio for the complete GUI overhaul! We couldn't be happier with how it all turned out. Be sure to add their game to your Steam wish list:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1703610/I_Just_Want_to_be_Single/

[h1]Future plans and pricing[/h1]
Development of [b]Chapter 5[/b] is currently in progress and planned to release later in 2024! The base price of [i][b]A Shot in the Dark[/b][/i] may increase with the [b]Chapter 5[/b] update, but we will give the community advance notice about any prices changes.

As a reminder, we also have NO plans to split the game into Books or Seasons. When you purchase [i][b]A Shot in the Dark[/b][/i], you will have access to all future updates until the game is complete (we have approx. 5 more updates planned). The same is true for the [b]Walkthrough & Guide DLC[/b].

[h2]Translations coming soon[/h2]
Currently only the [b]English version[/b] of the game is available for purchase. Translations to the following languages are in progress: Chinese (Simplified), French, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish. We plan to release the translated versions to Steam in the next few months!

[h2]Want to help with the translation process?[/h2]
You can find [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1853830/discussions/0/3934517363287161724/]more information in this post[/url]. Volunteers who help translate the game can request a Steam key. We have additional incentives for volunteers who make significant contributions to the translations.

[h1]Thank you for playing![/h1]
We appreciate all of our fans and players! If you enjoyed the game, please consider leaving a review. 

We hope you enjoy playing [b]Chapter 4[/b] of [i][b]A Shot in the Dark[/b][/i] as much as we've enjoyed making it. :)

notes.title: A Shot in the Dark: Dev Log 08-Mar-2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42292405/936e3da74f25a09e720092fc4b0f0f7f3b1692ab.png[/img]
[i]This dev log was originally posted on Patreon and SubscribeStar on March 8, 2024.[/i]

[h1]Cue the hallelujah choir![/h1]
[h2]The end of the development cycle is near![/h2]
All of the animations for [b]Chapter 4[/b] are posed and now we just have to wait for the remaining ones to finish rendering. Let's kick this celebratory dev log off with some animation previews from the ones that have already rendered:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42292405/5b6f7b379319643bd80e38312b48930cd684c312.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42292405/f2683c2874f7a96e08e0664e1b3f80d2e055666e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42292405/706c5d97dda4a0178024b1ee6b43cf04ef37a901.jpg[/img]
The last two scenes of [b]Chapter 4[/b] are in the process of being implemented into the code. We still have a lot of little polishing tasks and basic testing before we can hand things off to our testers, but the bulk of the coding is done.

This update was by far our most efficient in terms of coding implementation, and we have been happy with how quickly and smoothly that part has gone. Not only have we learned quite a bit from previous updates on how to "touch things once" and not duplicate work (which is harder than it sounds with a game as complex as this), we also have someone helping with coding who has been able to automate some of the more tedious aspects of the code implementation.

Right now, we plan to do everything in our power to release the [b]Chapter 4 BETA[/b] on Patreon and SubscribeStar during the last week of March. It will take a few weeks to prepare the final version for Steam release (we have to do further testing, add Steam achievements, etc) so that is tentatively planned for mid-April.

We know this development cycle has been a long one and we appreciate your patience with us as we navigated a lot of challenges and competing priorities during the second half of last year. With most of that out of the way, we have been happy with how things have gone so far in 2024 and we are feeling good about things going into [b]Chapter 5[/b].

Speaking of [b]Chapter 5[/b], we have also been doing the early work of planning and setting up a new chapter. As mentioned before, the plan has always been to do something really different with [b]Chapter 5[/b]. We won't say more right now, you'll have to wait until after we release [b]Chapter 4[/b] to find out what that means exactly. So, stay tuned!

Your reviews help other players like you find and enjoy our game.

[h1]Steam Launch[/h1]
We are so excited with how the [i][b]A Shot in the Dark[/b][/i] launch has gone on Steam! This was our second major goal for the year, along with releasing [b]V1.0[/b] of [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2149280/Prince_of_Suburbia__Part_2/]Prince of Suburbia[/url][/b][/i], and we are very proud for accomplishing both goals. 

It was a lot of work to get to this point, and we have a lot more work in front of us (particularly when it comes to releasing translated/localized versions). We still plan to a take some time this holiday season to reflect and celebrate all that we've accomplished so far!

The word count for scripts written is ~60K words, but not all of that is dialogue (some is narration, code instructions, dialogue tags, etc). We won't know the dialogue-only word count until we prep the chapter for translation (which happens after the writing has been implemented into the code).

The current render count is ~1,750 which definitely confirms this is shaping up to be our largest update in terms of renders. Renders for the [b]Delia[/b] lewd scene are almost complete, with only a day or two left to finish those up. Renders still need to be made for the non-lewd hypnosis scene. notes.title: A Shot in the Dark and Walkthrough & Guide DLC released today!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1853830/A_Shot_in_the_Dark/][b][i]A Shot in the Dark[/i] - Chapter 3[/b][/url] and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2707830/A_Shot_in_the_Dark__Walkthrough__Guide/][b]Walkthrough & Guide DLC[/b][/url] are now available for purchase on Steam!

[h2]Current version information[/h2]
The current version ([b]Chapter 3[/b]) of [i][b]A Shot in the Dark[/b][/i] includes: 70+ scenes, 116K+ words, 5K+ renders, 275+ animations, 115 songs, and 34 sound effects. 

[h2]Future plans and pricing[/h2]
Development of [b]Chapter 4[/b] is currently in progress and planned to release in early 2024! You can find past dev logs and progress updates [url=https://vim-studios.web.app/]via our website[/url]. Future dev logs will be posted on Steam.

The base price of both [i][b]A Shot in the Dark[/b][/i] and the [b]Walkthrough & Guide DLC[/b] will NOT increase with the future [b]Chapter 4[/b] release. You can safely wait until [b]Chapter 4[/b] releases if you want more content before purchasing the game. (We will give players advance notice about any prices changes after that point.)

We also have NO plans to split the game into Books or Seasons. When you purchase [i][b]A Shot in the Dark[/b][/i], you will have access to all future updates until the game is complete. The same is true for the [b]Walkthrough & Guide DLC[/b].

[h2]Please report any bugs or issues[/h2]
If you encounter any bugs or issues with the game, please reach out to us directly so we can help you! 

You can post in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1853830/discussions/]Discussion forum[/url] here on Steam, reach out to us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/7BtkMQCRmV]Discord server[/url], or contact our support email [url][u]vimstudios.vns@gmail.com[/u][/url]. 

If you report problems in a review, we may not see the report immediately.

[h2]Saves may be broken[/h2]
We do everything in our power to avoid broken saves, but there is a risk with every update that saves will be broken. 

Since releasing the [b]Chapter 1 DEMO[/b] on Steam, we have upgraded to Ren'Py 8+. Saves made with the older version of the game (including versions from other platforms) may be broken by this update. 

[h2]Entry Points available for all players[/h2]
We have [b]Entry Points[/b] for [b]Chapter 2[/b] and [b]Chapter 3[/b] available for players whose saves are broken. [b]Entry Points[/b] can be found in the [b]Walkthrough[/b] part of the menu, even though they are available to all players. 

You do NOT need to buy the DLC to access [b]Entry Points[/b]. (We will move them out of the [b]Walkthrough[/b] menu when we upgrade the GUI in the future.)

[h2]Speed Up Texting[/h2]
Just a friendly reminder that you can speed up texting with the setting in the Options menu!

[h2]Translations coming soon[/h2]
Currently only the [b]English version[/b] of the game is available for purchase. Translations to the following languages are in progress: Chinese (Simplified), French, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish. We plan to release the translated version to Steam as soon as we feel they are ready.

[h2]Want to help with the translation process?[/h2]
You can find [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1853830/discussions/0/3934517363287161724/]more information in this post[/url]. Volunteers who help translate the game can request a Steam key. We have additional incentives for volunteers who make significant contributions to the translations.

[h2]Thank you for playing![/h2]
We appreciate all of our fans and players! If you enjoyed the game, please consider leaving a review. 

We hope you enjoy playing [i][b]A Shot in the Dark[/b][/i] as much as we've enjoyed making it. :)

[h1][i]A Shot in the Dark[/i] Character Spotlight[/h1]
This week we're thrilled to introduce [b]Natalie[/b], the introspective and sensitive twin of [b]Sophie[/b]. This is our last character spotlight before [i][b]A Shot in the Dark[/b][/i] releases on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42292405/70dbe82ab415146d3cc9e3f1bfa2472b4d7ff3da.png[/img]
[h1]Introducing Natalie[/h1]
[b]Natalie[/b], a reserved and contemplative college junior, contrasts sharply with her vivacious twin sister, [b]Sophie[/b]. [b]Natalie[/b] finds solace in solitude and the serenity of nature, often preferring a quiet night with a book over a big college party. She joined the [i]Zeta Omega Chi[/i] sorority, despite not fitting in, in order to stay close to [b]Sophie[/b], her anchor in life despite their stark differences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42292405/e6e75a9ebacae9e40efd5c27fbfbec9ec1ca1012.png[/img]
[b]Natalie's[/b] journey is one of emotional depth and slow discovery. A true romantic, she aspires for a love that's deep and meaningful. Her cautious approach to relationships and intimacy reflects a deep desire to preserve parts of herself for someone truly special. If you are patient and willing to take things slow, your dedication will be rewarded in the end with [b]Natalie[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42292405/46f7cdf64d936d5f195031afb557f9283c02bc6a.png[/img]
[i][b]Likes:[/b][/i] Solitude, nature, romance novels
[i][b]Dislikes:[/b][/i] Recklessness, bad boys, big parties
[i][b]Quote:[/b][/i] "I want to save some parts of myself... for someone who matters."
